description: This file defines the 'GenericHelper' interface in the OFBiz framework, providing methods for CRUD operations and query support for generic entity data management.

classes.name: GenericHelper
classes.description: The interface outlining general helper methods for handling generic entity operations such as create, find, update, and delete within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getHelperName
methods.description: Returns the name of the server configuration associated with this helper.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new entity in the database from a GenericValue.

methods.name: createAll
methods.description: Inserts a list of GenericValues into the database.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Finds a generic entity by its primary key.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKeyPartial
methods.description: Finds a generic entity by its primary key, returning only specified fields.

methods.name: findAllByPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Finds multiple entities by a list of primary keys.

methods.name: removeByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Removes an entity identified by its primary key.

methods.name: findByMultiRelation
methods.description: Finds entities related via multiple relations.

methods.name: findListIteratorByCondition
methods.description: Returns an iterator over entities that satisfy specified conditions.

methods.name: storeByCondition
methods.description: Stores (updates) a group of entities matching a condition.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores (updates) an entity from a GenericValue.

methods.name: checkDataSource
methods.description: Validates the data source against entity definitions, optionally adding missing entities or fields.
